whole_paragraph_words: Full observer/callback bodies/roles/allocations join every API/parser operation, eval, installed wrapper and source argument. Parser receiver roles are declared, native identity unmeasured. Named helper graphs/active paths retain supplied/default inputs and returned argument-builders. Compiled parameterless callback/refusal/helper wrappers bind source regex bodies/labels and both nested throw phases. Returned helpers are inactive frames. Source derivation precedes contiguous recorded function/argument order.

Each refusal retains its authored named subtest. Observer saves Test::More delegate, receives name/body/extras, wraps the body with the compiled-helper observer, forwards callback arguments to the body and extras to the saved delegate. Authored subtests supply no extras; body/own-callback visible arguments are empty. Public/own entry retains authored names and CODE kind without callback identity.

Original do './t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t' captures $@/$!/defined($ok). Diagnostic require names that file without changing source do or proving formatter identity. Public POD documents named callbacks/extras, do-file returns/errors and require's do-file mechanism. Dated current Perl/Test::More supplies public interface evidence; original framework version remains unmeasured.

Finite operation/helper/body/public/entry/load class/guard/phase/operand roles join. Inherited operands remain opaque evidence to prior predicates, without formatter/coordinate/address oracles; an opaque inner-frame change passes those own/public predicates but breaks whole forwarding.

Complete headers join full source expressions and frame aliases, including Test::Builder/Test::More body/delegate/entry/do-load order. Qualified current literal/quote/escape/truncation/count grammar and full hidden source values retain; authored regex constructor alternatives stay explicit. Reference class/kind spellings and private intervals conserve whole original bytes without native identity. Independent lexical/source/allocation reconstruction and fresh complete prerequisites qualify. A different proper public name prefix passes the limited predecessor but fails the full token contract. Model/population/member/order/phase/role/kind/family/operand/quote/truncation/count/opaque/scope/native-promotion controls reject; prior meanings conserve.

Core qualifies source/address roles, active holders and own coordinates; external framework coordinates remain unmeasured. Original provider/hooks/classes/native addresses, callback/regex/object/referent/receiver identities, private framework/eval/parser internals and formatter settings/flags/encoding remain unmeasured. Consumer/alias/full-semantic/cold/candidate-parent/permanent/hot/host-native repairs and visual QA remain open.
